contexts.text: Thou shalt break forth towards the sea and towards the east () = the infinite extension of good... To break forth = extension; here, infinite extension, because predicated of the Lord.
It hath broken forth to a multitude () = fecundity afterwards.
Unless evils were permitted to break forth...
Waters shall break forth in the desert () = that truths shall be opened where they were not before. AE 518:4.
To break forth to the right and the left () = amplification as to the good of charity and as to the truth of faith. AE 768:7.
